explanation: The kinematic point passed physical preflight (with lookup-table coverage unverified because the table was absent), using eta standard CLAS12 RG-K settings: 6.53 GeV beam, vcut=0.166 GeV^2, full O(alpha) RC. EXCLURAD could not run: the generated eta build has no executable and the required eta lookup table maid07-PPpi.tbl is missing from the working directory. Therefore EXCLURAD produced no valid delta or sigma_Born.
